name: Positive 4-3-3 DM Wide

slots.why: Distributes short or long depending on the press.
Support full-back gives width and safe passing options.
Central defender. Cover is the alternate.
Central defender on the right. Cover is the alternate, but only one Cover can be used.
Ball-winning midfielder shields the defence and starts the counter-press.
Deep-lying playmaker passes forward from the middle.
Supporting central midfielder links the playmaker with the forwards.
Inside forward cuts in from the left to shoot and attack the box.
Winger stays wide and delivers, giving width on the right.
Lone striker: Advanced Forward runs in behind. Poacher is the alternate.

description: A modern 4-3-3 with a holder, two eights and complementary wide forwards.
whyGood: It offers strong pitch coverage, good rest defence and multiple progression routes.
whyThisShape: A 4-3-3 with a holding midfielder, two central midfielders and three forwards. The ball-winner shields the defence, the playmaker passes forward, and the wide forwards give width and goals.
whenToUse: A good all-round attacking system when you have a reliable holding midfielder and two forwards who can score, against opponents who defend with two banks of four.
whenNotToUse: When you have no ball-winner to hold the midfield, or against a team that pushes wide players onto your full-backs.

instructionRationale.Shorter Passing: Keeps possession through the midfield three.
instructionRationale.Play Out Of Defence: The holding midfielder offers a short option from the defenders.
instructionRationale.Work Ball Into Box: Patient movement of the ball until a clear chance opens up.
instructionRationale.Counter-Press: Presses at once after losing the ball, led by the ball-winner.
instructionRationale.Counter: Attacks quickly when the ball is won, using the wide forwards.
instructionRationale.Higher Line of Engagement: Presses higher up the pitch to keep the play in the opponent's half.
instructionRationale.Standard Defensive Line: A balanced line keeps the defence compact.
